notes.title: Speakeasy Maintenance Complete
notes.notes:
January 15, 2025

Speakeasy maintenance is now complete! 

[b]macOS Users[/b]: Speakeasy is now playable from the Steam Launcher. 

[b]All Users[/b]: Please be sure that the game has updated in your Steam Library and you have the current version. The game might need to be uninstalled and then reinstalled to show the changes.

To make sure your Steam Library has the most current version of the game, right click "Speakeasy" in your Library list > Properties > Updates. The "Build ID" shown at the bottom should be 17019656. 

[b]If you're still experiencing issues, contact Open Late Games support here: [url=https://openlategames.com/contact/]https://openlategames.com/contact/[/url][/b]

notes.title: Speakeasy Maintenance
notes.notes:
January 15, 2025

Speakeasy is currently undergoing maintenance to address issues with the Steam Launcher that is not allowing the game to open for some players.

notes.title: Speakeasy V2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Speakeasy V2.0 updates and changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game has been ported to Ren'py from Unity
[*] Game size has been reduced
[*] New UI and menus
[*] Additional accessibility settings
[*] Text edits: corrections 
[*] Text edits: rewritten sections for the "Sexual Content OFF" version
[*] Sound effects added in game and in navigational areas
[*] Save files from the previous versions, 1.1 and 1.2, are not compatible with 2.0 and will not transfer over
[*] Unlocked CGs from previous versions, 1.1 and 1.2, are not compatible with 2.0 and will not transfer over
[/list]

An automatic update will be pushed to all players on Steam. For support, please contact Open Late Games.

notes.title: Speakeasy V1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44099439/4857ad7dd81e9e2def6ac7591787073ce2e89e30.png[/img]

[b]Speakeasy V1.2 is now available.[/b]

In this update to the game, players now have the option to turn off NSFW content.

Please note the following:

1. Once NSFW ON or NSFW OFF have been selected after starting a new game, players will not be able to change this choice during a route. A new game must be started in order to make a different selection.

2. There are no replacement scenes where the NSFW content originally occurred. Instead, players will experience a short transition where the NSFW was cut.
